title: Rpcs3 (LinuxServer.io)
description: RPCS3 is a multi-platform open-source Sony Playstation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS and Freebsd.
tagline: A multi-platform open-source Sony Playstation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS and Freebsd.
